title: LIBERATORY OPERATOR SET: TECHNICAL HARDENING SPECIFICATION
creator: Lee Sharks; The Assembly
description:
A v1.3 technical-hardening specification by Lee Sharks / the Assembly for the Liberatory Operator Set under pressure from the Capital Operator Stack.

The document formalizes COS operators, LOS operators, operator interdependence, failure signatures, graded degradation, recovery triggers, and Meta-Resistance. It explicitly describes LOS as self-extrapolating but not totalizing and limits its scope to platform capital and accelerated semantic systems. The claimed COS failure cascade and classification of the Medium event as a documented safety-operator failure are framework interpretations and predictions, not independently validated platform science.
reading: Alarm → Threshold → Force → Touch → Touch → Touch
